candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on /v1/checkout. Traces show every checkout correlation failing with an upstream 500 from order:8000, and gateway metrics show 16 502s vs 2.7 200s on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause inside order (db, payment, inventory) is not established; only the order 500 propagation is observed.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s caused by order service 500s on /v1/orders across all correlation IDs; gateway metrics confirm elevated 502 rate on /v1/checkout. Topology confirms gateway->order dependency. The specific fault within order is not yet evidenced.
